notes: D6-D8 routing revision: keep the Shinhotaka D6/D7/D8 selector, but move Shirakawago earlier. Shirakawago is now D6 by default and only moves to D7 when D6 is selected for Shinhotaka; D8 never goes west to Shirakawago. D8 is reserved for eastbound Shinhotaka or Takayama/Hida Great Limestone Cave before Matsumoto. D7 Jan 15 keeps Santera Mairi as an optional bonus.
